# skill_scalability_crawler

`module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/` reads each controlled file of the files matrix against the Skills a hand marks for it, writes one report per file a hand reads, and its snapshot. A hand starts it with `make skills-crawl`, which runs `make skills-sync` first, and nothing schedules it; it gates nothing, writes nothing but its reports and its snapshot, and commits nothing (`AGENTS.md` § Values); the rules draw the destination, and a report says where one file stands from it.

## Conformities

- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-MATRIX-IS-PATH-BY-SKILL`
  - Description: The matrix a hand edits stays a path against a Skill, and the finer resolution happens inside the crawl.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`
  - Expected: The `files` tab headed `path`, then one column per Skill headed by its stem; a row per path — a file or a glob from the root of the tree — once; a cell holding `X` or nothing; a file two globs reach takes the union of both rows' marks.
  - Exception: none
- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-ROW-REACHES-A-FILE-AND-NO-GENERATED-ONE`
  - Description: Every row of the files matrix reaches at least one file, and never a generated one: a rendered Skill or the snapshot is not a controlled file.
  - Scope: `module_skills/skills_sheet.xlsx`, `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawl.py`
  - Expected: `build_controlled_files()` globbing each row from the root of the tree over files alone, a folder reached through a glob such as `module_data/**/*.py`; a row that matches no file — a bare folder among them — or that reaches a document `make skills-sync` renders or `skills_status.json` ends the crawl in one line.
  - Exception: none
- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-FINDING-NAMES-A-RULE`
  - Description: A departure names the rule it departs from, so a reader can go to the rule and disagree with the rule.
  - Scope: `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawl.py`, `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawlers_mission.md`
  - Expected: An exact `rule_id` of a Skill sent — whose prefix names the document it is written in (`RULE-TABLES-ID-GRAMMAR`) — on a line `rule_id | file:line | problem | correction`.
  - Exception: none
- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-ONE-CURRENT-REPORT-PER-FILE`
  - Description: A controlled file has one current report, the vendor's answer as it came, and no history.
  - Scope: `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/config.py`, `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawl.py`
  - Expected: `store/status/reports_after_crawled_files/<path>.report.md` — `report_path()` under `REPORTS_DIR` — written whole, and only then the file `done`: the line `<path> · <vendor> · <finished_at_utc>`, a blank line, then the answer; never appended to or summarised; kept until the next crawl resets `REPORTS_DIR`, a failed file or Ctrl-C deleting none.
  - Exception: none
- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-SNAPSHOT-KEEPS-ITS-KEYS`
  - Description: The snapshot answers where each controlled file stands and when it finished, and takes on nothing else.
  - Scope: `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/status.py`
  - Expected: A row per controlled file with `path`, `state`, `vendor`, `finished_at_utc` and `report`, sorted by path; `report` only once the file is `done`, every missing value `null`.
  - Exception: none
- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-ONE-VENDOR-IS-ACTIVE`
  - Description: One vendor is active, and the crawl uses it.
  - Scope: `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/vendors_for_crawling.toml`, `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawl.py`
  - Expected: Exactly one vendor has `active = true`; its `argv` is a non-empty list.
  - Exception: none
- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-VENDOR-IS-DATA`
  - Description: A vendor is data: its whole command line is the `argv` of its table in `vendors_for_crawling.toml`, and no line of the crawler names a vendor, a model or a flag.
  - Scope: `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/vendors_for_crawling.toml`, `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawl.py`
  - Expected: `argv` holds the program and every argument — model, effort, permissions — and gives the agent no tool, one message in and one answer out; the crawl runs it once per controlled file, one after another, with `shell=False` from the root of the tree, the message on stdin and the answer read from stdout, in its user's own login; no API key in the file.
  - Exception: none

## Workflow

- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-SNAPSHOT-FOLLOWS-EVERY-CHANGE`
  - Description: An action that changes something ends by writing the snapshot, so the snapshot never lags the reports.
  - Scope: `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawl.py`
  - Expected: `write_skills_status()` after every transition — `pending` for every controlled file before the first vendor call, `running` before each, `done` or `failed` after each, `interrupted` on Ctrl-C — so the snapshot never lags the reports.
  - Exception: none
- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-FAILED-FILE-DOES-NOT-STOP-THE-CRAWL`
  - Description: A file the vendor fails is `failed`, and the crawl goes on to the next controlled file; the crawl fails only after the last one.
  - Scope: `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawl.py`
  - Expected: `failed` on a non-zero exit, an empty answer, no answer within `AGENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, a command that cannot start or text that cannot be decoded; the reason one line `<path>: <why>` on stderr and no report for the file; then the next controlled file; the crawl ending non-zero once every file is processed.
  - Exception: none

## UI_TUI

- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-REFUSAL-IS-ONE-LINE`
  - Description: A state the crawler cannot read is one named line, not a validation pass.
  - Scope: `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/status.py`, `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawl.py`
  - Expected: One `SystemExit` line naming the file and what is wrong; `make skills-crawl` ending on it, exit 1.
  - Exception: none

## Scalability

- `SCALABILITY-CRAWLER-GROWS-BY-DATA-ONLY`
  - Description: The crawler grows by data only: a new file, Skill, module or sub-module adds rows to the sheet and marks to the files matrix and changes no line of the crawler.
  - Scope: `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/crawl.py`, `module_skills/sub_module_scalability_crawler/status.py`
  - Expected: Each addition to the tree leaves the crawler byte-identical; the crawler holds no `if`, dependency, special case, parser or branch named for a module, a Skill or a controlled file.
  - Exception: none
